column3: “His sleep happened on him” is rendered “his sleep left him”; the meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.
“My spirit was troubled to know” is rendered “my spirit is anxious to understand.”
After “in Aramaic” the text switches from Hebrew to Aramaic. Close to the Aramaic.
“The word from me is assured” is rendered “The command from me is firm,” and “made members” “torn limb from limb.”
“You are gaining time” is rendered “you are bargaining for time.”
“One is your decree” is rendered “there is only one decree for you”; “until the time is changed” is rendered “until the situation is changed.”
“Sent back counsel and discretion” is rendered “replied with discretion and discernment”; “chief of the executioners” is rendered “captain of the king’s bodyguard.”
“Secret” is rendered “mystery”; NASB adds “in order that they might.”
“From antiquity to perpetuity” is rendered “forever and ever.”
“The sons of the exile of Judah” is rendered “the exiles from Judah.”
“At the end of days” is rendered “in the latter days,” and “visions of your head” “visions in your mind.”
“Thoughts of your heart” is rendered “thoughts of your mind.”
